description: Issue 6 (P2): make every raw-SQL live_classes INSERT explicit about microphone_authorization_mode so tests no longer depend on the DB column default (currently LEGACY after 20261030; becomes SFU_AUTHORITATIVE after FEAT-006's reconciliation migration). Three files: the rawInsertLC helper + 9 call sites in backend/src/tests/integration/live-class.integration.test.js, the createTestLC helper + ~12 call sites in backend/src/tests/live-class-real-db.test.js, and the Step-10 diagnostic INSERT in backend/fix-live-class-columns.js. No production controller/service/route/middleware files may be touched.
steps: Extend rawInsertLC in backend/src/tests/integration/live-class.integration.test.js (lines ~139-160) per the design: build modeColumns/modeValues/modeParams conditionally from data.microphoneAuthorizationMode, keep the existing 13 leading ? placeholders and the inline literals 1,1,0,0 for screenShareEnabled/whiteboardEnabled/quranPanelEnabled/isRecorded, splice ...modeParams immediately before now, now. Omitting the mode must produce byte-identical SQL to today.

Update the nine rawInsertLC call sites (lines ~233, ~266, ~285-289, ~324, ~355, ~407, ~441, ~490, ~551) to pass microphoneAuthorizationMode: 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE'. At the SUPER_ADMIN GATE-F02 SCHEDULED site (~285) include the comment: // Mode is irrelevant: assertSchoolAccess fires a 403 before any microphone check. SFU_AUTHORITATIVE is used as the application-consistent default.

Extend createTestLC in backend/src/tests/live-class-real-db.test.js (lines ~88-122) per the design: hasMode/modeColumn/modePlaceholder/modeValue derived from p.microphoneAuthorizationMode, preserve the inline 1,1,0,0 literals, splice ...modeValue just before now, now. Add the explanatory comment block from the design.

Update every createTestLC call site (~12: GATE-7A, GATE-8, GATE-11, GATE-9, GATE-10, GATE-6, GATE-1/2/3 concurrency, GATE-4 slot release, GATE-5 reconnect, GATE-12) to pass microphoneAuthorizationMode: 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE' (one-line 'mode irrelevant' comment allowed on pure GET-authorization sites). No call site depends on the LEGACY default for its assertions, so the uniform SFU_AUTHORITATIVE choice is behavior-preserving.

Edit backend/fix-live-class-columns.js Step 10 'Quick creation test (raw SQL)' INSERT (~line 140) to include microphone_authorization_mode = 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE' in the column list and VALUES, with the comment from the design (mirrors what rawCreateLiveClass always writes). No other statement in that file inserts into live_classes.
Run node --check on all three files.
Commit with message 'test(live-class): make microphone mode explicit in raw-SQL test helpers (Issue 6)'.
acceptance_criteria: rawInsertLC and createTestLC accept microphoneAuthorizationMode and include the column in the INSERT only when provided (omission = byte-identical SQL to before).
Every rawInsertLC and createTestLC call site explicitly passes microphoneAuthorizationMode: 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE' (or carries an explanatory comment where the mode is irrelevant).
backend/fix-live-class-columns.js Step 10 INSERT sets microphone_authorization_mode explicitly.
No production file under backend/src/controllers, services, routes, middleware is modified (git diff confirms).

backend/src/tests/integration/live-class.integration.test.js passes against a migrated test database (its scenarios' meanings unchanged: GATE-10 POST /start now exercises a no-op ensureProtectedScheduledMicrophoneMode because the row is already SFU_AUTHORITATIVE).
verification: node --check backend/src/tests/integration/live-class.integration.test.js && node --check backend/src/tests/live-class-real-db.test.js && node --check backend/fix-live-class-columns.js — exit code 0.
Create the disposable DB once: & 'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe' -uroot -e "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS halqa_test; CREATE DATABASE halqa_test CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;"

cd backend; $env:DATABASE_URL='mysql://root@localhost:3306/halqa_test'; npx prisma migrate deploy — applies all migrations through 20261114 (20261030 included; expect 'already applied' only for none — local DB halqa_test is fresh).

cd backend; $env:DATABASE_URL='mysql://root@localhost:3306/halqa_test'; $env:NODE_ENV='test'; $env:JWT_SECRET='ci_integration_jwt_secret_at_least_32_characters!!'; $env:JWT_REFRESH_SECRET='ci_integration_refresh_secret_32_chars!!'; $env:PORT='5002'; npm run test:integration -- src/tests/integration/live-class.integration.test.js — all tests pass.

Optional real-db run (if fixture identities inserted): insert the 8 header users (TEACHER_ID, SCHOOL_ADMIN_ID, STUDENT_ID, SUPER_ADMIN_ID, NO_SCHOOL_ID, SCHOOL2_STUDENT with roles/status ACTIVE/emailVerified 1) and 2 schools (SCHOOL_ID, SCHOOL2_ID) with the exact UUIDs from the file header into halqa_test, then npx jest --config jest.integration.config.js --roots src/tests --testMatch '**/live-class-real-db.test.js' src/tests/live-class-real-db.test.js with DATABASE_URL set — passes. If blocked, record why in findings and rely on node --check + the integration suite (createTestLC is only called with LIVE rows, so the start-guard trigger never fires for them).
